name: NGC 6753, SN 2019mhm field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 6753, a spiral galaxy and host of SN 2019mhm, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2019mhmhost-hubble
story: A spiral galaxy wrapped in an invisible corona of hot gas, one of only two known spirals where such a halo had been detected. It hosted SN 2019mhm, a Type II-P supernova.

claims.text: SN 2019mhm is a Type II-P supernova located in NGC 6753
NGC 6753 is one of only two known spiral galaxies massive and close enough for their coronae to be detected
Coronae are huge, invisible regions of hot gas around a galaxy; NGC 6753 has a hot corona
